log() { echo "[fetch_token] $1"; }

case "$SECRET_SOURCE" in
  aws)
    if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "ERROR: AWS CLI (aws) not found" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    # Retrieve secret (SecretString). It may be plain token or JSON payload.
    SECRET_VALUE=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$SECRET_ID" --query SecretString --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [[ -z "$SECRET_VALUE" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Could not retrieve secret from AWS Secrets Manager (ID: $SECRET_ID)" >&2; exit 1

    # If SecretString is JSON, try common token fields; otherwise take as-is
    if echo "$SECRET_VALUE" | jq -e 'has("access_token")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      TOKEN=$(echo "$SECRET_VALUE" | jq -r '.access_token')
    elif echo "$SECRET_VALUE" | jq -e '.token' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      TOKEN=$(echo "$SECRET_VALUE" | jq -r '.token')
    else
      TOKEN="$SECRET_VALUE"

  vault)

      if [[ -n "$TOKEN_JSON" ]]; then
        TOKEN=$(echo "$TOKEN_JSON" | jq -r '.access_token')
      fi
    fi
    if [[ -z "$TOKEN" || "$TOKEN" == "null" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Could not fetch token from Vault at path $SECRET_PATH" >&2; exit 1
    fi

  azure)

      echo "ERROR: Azure CLI (az) not found" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    # Assumes you’re already authenticated (az login)

    if [[ -z "$TOKEN" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Could not retrieve token from Azure Key Vault" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    ;;
  gcp)
    if ! command -v gcloud >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "ERROR: Google Cloud SDK (gcloud) not found" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    TOKEN="$(gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=Northwind-EmployeeRecords-AccessToken 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -z "$TOKEN" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: Could not retrieve token from Google Secret Manager" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    ;;
  k8s)
    if ! command -v kubectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "ERROR: kubectl not found" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    SECRET_BASE64="$(kubectl get secret northwind-employee-records-access-token -o jsonpath="{.data.access_token}")" || true
    if [[ -n "$SECRET_BASE64" ]]; then
